write.route_a: validated payload fragment -> held {slot,fragment,data} child request -> matching child ack advances parent order
write.full_kv: validated payload fragment -> held {slot,fragment,data} child request -> matching child ack advances parent order

read.route_a: READY/identity/generation/range parent check -> one child read -> held outward response
read.full_kv: READY/identity/generation/range parent check -> one child read -> held outward response

non_equivalences.geometry: Route-A payload fragment coordinate is fixed 9-bit/512; Full-KV coordinate is parameterized and focused wrapper test uses 3 bits
non_equivalences.fill_provenance: Route-A packed lease/page and optional sidecar completion differ from Full-KV baseline producer fill
non_equivalences.lifecycle_fault_shell: Route-A packed SourceInstance/R6 path differs from Full-KV baseline-local source and terminal-retire path

cost_rule: both payload interiors and parent adapters remain nonzero; Route-A sidecar and packed controls remain Route-A incremental
